name: @sos-2/runtime-contracts
description: SOS 2.0 Runtime Contracts (Work Order P5): the typed runtime vocabulary for runtime/execution integration — the harness integration priority order of spec/productization-execution-architecture.md section 4 (native API/SDK/app-server -> MCP/equivalent protocol -> local companion/service bridge -> browser/IDE extension -> UI automation LAST) as a typed, deterministic selection model (SOS must never require an extension when an equivalent safe API is available); runtime capability envelopes (capability + operation vocabulary + candidate integration surfaces); the bounded-environment description (filesystem scope, network egress policy, isolation level, resource limits, environment variable NAMES only — never secret values, mirroring the P3 environment contract discipline); and the non-semantic identifier discipline (runtime identifiers are NEVER SOS semantic identities — the guard rejects sos://-shaped values loudly). Pure types + guards + pure functions; no process.env, no clock, no network, no randomness. The P3 body-provider configuration vocabulary (@sos-2/infra-deployment) is aligned BY SPEC (both mirror section 3 of the execution architecture) and deliberately NOT imported — each vocabulary is independently pinned to the spec surfaces, following the P3 structural-isolation precedent.
